<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>

<?import javafx.scene.layout.*?>
<?import javafx.scene.control.*?>
<?import javafx.geometry.Insets?>

<BorderPane xmlns="http://javafx.com/javafx"
            xmlns:fx="http://javafx.com/fxml"
            fx:controller="com.example.ui.DetailController"
            prefWidth="1920" prefHeight="1080"
            style="-fx-background-color: white;">

    <!-- Top -->
    <top>
        <HBox alignment="CENTER_LEFT" spacing="16">
            <padding><Insets top="24" right="28" bottom="10" left="28"/></padding>

            <Button text="←" onAction="#onBackCatalogue"
                    style="-fx-font-size: 18px; -fx-background-color: transparent;"/>

            <Label text="Détail du plat"
                   style="-fx-font-size: 44px; -fx-font-weight: 900;"/>

            <Region HBox.hgrow="ALWAYS"/>

            <Button fx:id="cartTotalBtn"
                    text="🧺  0,00 €"
                    onAction="#onOpenPanier"
                    style="-fx-background-color: #fbc02d; -fx-font-weight: 800; -fx-background-radius: 18; -fx-padding: 10 18;"/>
        </HBox>
    </top>

    <!-- Center -->
    <center>
        <HBox spacing="40">
            <padding><Insets top="20" right="60" bottom="20" left="60"/></padding>

            <!-- Image (placeholder) -->
            <StackPane prefWidth="780" prefHeight="480"
                       style="-fx-background-color: #d9d9d9; -fx-background-radius: 12;">
                <Label text="image plat" style="-fx-text-fill: #666; -fx-font-size: 18px;"/>
            </StackPane>

            <!-- Infos -->
            <VBox spacing="18" prefWidth="900">
                <Label fx:id="nameLabel"
                       text="Pad Thaï crevettes"
                       style="-fx-font-size: 54px; -fx-font-weight: 900;"/>

                <Label fx:id="descLabel"
                       text="Nouilles sautées avec crevettes, légumes et sauce tamarin"
                       style="-fx-font-size: 26px; -fx-text-fill: #666;"/>

                <Label fx:id="priceLabel"
                       text="14,90 €"
                       style="-fx-font-size: 54px; -fx-font-weight: 900;"/>

                <Label text="Options" style="-fx-font-size: 38px; -fx-font-weight: 900;"/>

                <!-- Epice -->
                <VBox spacing="8">
                    <Label text="Épice : doux / moyen / fort" style="-fx-font-size: 24px;"/>
                    <HBox spacing="18">
                        <RadioButton fx:id="rbDoux" text="Doux" toggleGroup="$tgEpice"/>
                        <RadioButton fx:id="rbMoyen" text="Moyen" toggleGroup="$tgEpice" selected="true"/>
                        <RadioButton fx:id="rbFort" text="Fort" toggleGroup="$tgEpice"/>
                    </HBox>
                </VBox>

                <!-- Accompagnement -->
                <VBox spacing="8">
                    <Label text="Accompagnement : riz / nouilles" style="-fx-font-size: 24px;"/>
                    <HBox spacing="18">
                        <RadioButton fx:id="rbRiz" text="Riz" toggleGroup="$tgAcc" selected="true"/>
                        <RadioButton fx:id="rbNouilles" text="Nouilles" toggleGroup="$tgAcc"/>
                    </HBox>
                </VBox>

                <!-- Quantité + CTA -->
                <HBox alignment="CENTER_LEFT" spacing="20">
                    <Label text="Quantité" style="-fx-font-size: 34px; -fx-font-weight: 900;"/>

                    <Button text="−" onAction="#onMinus"
                            style="-fx-font-size: 22px; -fx-padding: 10 16; -fx-background-radius: 10;"/>
                    <Label fx:id="qtyLabel" text="1"
                           style="-fx-font-size: 32px; -fx-font-weight: 900;"/>
                    <Button text="+" onAction="#onPlus"
                            style="-fx-font-size: 22px; -fx-padding: 10 16; -fx-background-radius: 10;"/>

                    <Region HBox.hgrow="ALWAYS"/>

                    <Button text="Ajouter au panier" onAction="#onAddToCart"
                            style="-fx-background-color: #fbc02d; -fx-font-size: 36px; -fx-font-weight: 900; -fx-background-radius: 22; -fx-padding: 14 30;"/>
                </HBox>

            </VBox>
        </HBox>
    </center>

</BorderPane>
